title: Ocular-systemic genetic architecture atlas: reproducibility code and derived outputs
description: Reproducible code and derived outputs for a cross-trait genetic-architecture atlas spanning three ocular phenotypes and six systemic phenotypes. This release includes portable analysis scripts, frozen configuration, derived summary tables, audit reports, and figures. Raw GWAS summary statistics, consortium-restricted files, LD reference panels, and large genome-wide intermediate tables are excluded and must be obtained from their original providers under the applicable access and citation terms. Funding: none. Competing interests: none declared.
